title: Analysis code and statistics package for: An albedo-organized gradient in nocturnal surface-air temperature offsets across cities: a flux-tower benchmark for urban canopy schemes
description:
Analysis code, model-run configurations and the complete statistics package underlying every number, table and figure of the manuscript submitted to Urban Climate. The nocturnal apparent radiometric surface temperature is derived from tower upward and downward longwave radiation at 19 records of the harmonized Urban-PLUMBER collection through one inversion applied identically to observations and model output, and its offset from tower air temperature is compared across sites against offline runs of two urban canopy schemes, TEB v4.1.2 and CLM-Urban (CLM5.0/CLMU).

Contents: the generator chain from processed model output to the published tables (single-source-of-truth statistics file plus its companion packages: city-block permutation inference, paired scheme-difference bootstrap, observation-error propagation, temporal and seasonal sampling, constrained-configuration experiments, metric-family comparison, albedo and sky-emissivity check, material perturbations); the run tooling for both schemes; the differentiable single-layer probe; and the figure and table generators.

This deposit contains our own analysis code only. The TEB source (CeCILL v2.1) is referenced by its own software archive and the Urban-PLUMBER observations (CC-BY-4.0) by their versioned data record; neither is redistributed here. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
